# escapeRegExp

<link-summary>Escapes the characters that carry meaning inside a regular expression.</link-summary>

<web-summary>escapeRegExp() — Escapes the characters that carry meaning inside a regular expression. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/string</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function escapeRegExp(value: string): string;
```

Put user input through this before building a `RegExp` from it, and a dot stays a dot instead of matching any character.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type     | Description                                 |
| :-------- | :------- | :------------------------------------------ |
| `value`   | `string` | The string to escape. It must not be empty. |

## Returns

`string` — the escaped string, safe to drop into a pattern.

## Throws

| Exception              | Condition                               |
| :--------------------- | :-------------------------------------- |
| `EmptyStringException` | the value is not a string, or is empty. |

## Examples

### Escaping

```javascript
escapeRegExp("a.b*c"); // => "a\\.b\\*c"

new RegExp(escapeRegExp("1.5")).test("1x5"); // => false
```
